headline: Case Study | Dispatch Modernization for Kestrelmoor Freight Cooperative
client_summary: Kestrelmoor Freight Cooperative is a member-owned freight network of about 1,400 independent carriers across nine US states.
problem:
Dispatch ran on a 1990s IBM i system with 310,000 lines of RPG. Loads were keyed in by hand and offered to carriers by phone, taking a median of 47 minutes to place, and trucks often ran home empty. Two of the four people who understood the code were close to retiring.

Radiant converted the RPG estate to Java services with AI-assisted code conversion, reviewed by engineers and tested against a year of real loads, and built load matching and a carrier app on top. The legacy system was switched off in month nine, on schedule.

metrics.text: 74% reduction in time to place a load
18% fewer empty miles across the fleet
82% of carriers active in the app in six months
